There is one refactoring I'd suggest: we have `CopyTooltip` wrapper that has a similar logic as the new component. It makes sense to wrap the shadcn button into that like:
```
<CopyTooltip text={address}>
  <button className={cn('shrink-0 ...', className)} aria-label="Copy address" type="button">
    <Copy className="size-3.5 ..." />
  </button>
</CopyTooltip>
```

It removes some duplicated logic and makes the wording consistent.
